title.en: Keep concrete pump mixing seal φ65 as printed while Quarry only supplies the map

description.en: The concrete pump mixing seal φ65 note follows the outline of Quarry. The φ65 mixing seal is a set on the Xingtai mixing-seal page for concrete pumps and mixer pumps. Confirm this outer diameter on the mixer. The page does not say which published mixer pump uses φ65.

h1.en: concrete pump mixing seal φ65: sections borrowed from Quarry
h1.zh: concrete pump mixing seal φ65：章节借自《Quarry》

directAnswer.en: For concrete pump mixing seal φ65, copy the printed fragments and ignore any urge to borrow a figure from Quarry. Quarry only lends its headings. The φ65 mixing seal is a set on the Xingtai mixing-seal page for concrete pumps and mixer pumps. Confirm this outer diameter on the mixer. The page does not say which published mixer pump uses φ65.
directAnswer.zh: 写concrete pump mixing seal φ65时，只抄已印片段，不要从来源页《Quarry》借数字。《Quarry》只出借标题。 φ65 搅拌密封是邢台搅拌密封页上的一套，用于混凝土泵和搅拌泵。请在搅拌装置上核对这一外径。页面没有写哪一台已公布搅拌泵使用 φ65。

body.en: Where the source outline says “History”, the catalogue fragment below is the fragment a buyer is allowed to copy. Sizes on the page: φ65, φ80, and generation kits (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th) plus an upper-pump kit. Those generation rows and the upper-pump row do not print an extra outer diameter. This note is only φ65. Unit: set. Material and life are missing. Integrated Mixer Pump prints 45 kW / 14 kW, a 400 or 500 mixer note, and pipe 100 / 125 mm. Diesel Mixer Integrated Pump prints a 400 or 500 mixer note and no pipe diameter. Neither page names φ65 or φ80. φ65 is not repeated on the other wear-part size lists in this catalogue. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 来源大纲写到“历史”时，下面这句才是买方可以照抄的目录原文。 页面尺寸：φ65、φ80，以及第一代至第四代套件和上泵套件。分代行和上泵行没有另印外径。本文只写 φ65。单位：套。材料和寿命缺失。 搅拌泵一体机印了 45 kW / 14 kW、400 或 500 搅拌的说明，以及管子 100 / 125 mm。柴油搅拌泵一体机印了 400 或 500 搅拌的说明，没有管径。两页都没有写 φ65 或 φ80。 φ65 没有在本目录其他易损件尺寸清单里重复出现。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: A reader who opens the source page will find “Stone industry”. This note keeps the heading and puts the printed fragment beneath it. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. Write mixing seal φ65 and the quantity in sets. Do not substitute a generation kit unless that is the row you checked. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: 打开来源页会看到“来源章节：Stone industry”。这篇笔记保留该标题，并把已印片段放在标题下面。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 写明搅拌密封 φ65 和套数。除非核对到的就是分代那一行，否则不要改成分代套件。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: “Types of rock” organises the source article. Organised under it here is catalogue language, unchanged in its figures. The φ65 mixing seal is a set on the Xingtai mixing-seal page for concrete pumps and mixer pumps. Confirm this outer diameter on the mixer. The page does not say which published mixer pump uses φ65. This wear-part page does not name a pump model for the size. The same numeral on a pump page is not an assignment. Confirm the size on the machine. The outline does not complete a blank.
body.zh: “类型的 岩石”用来组织来源文章。组织在它下面的，是目录里的说法，数字保持原样。 φ65 搅拌密封是邢台搅拌密封页上的一套，用于混凝土泵和搅拌泵。请在搅拌装置上核对这一外径。页面没有写哪一台已公布搅拌泵使用 φ65。 这张易损件页没有把该尺寸写到某一台已公布泵上。泵页上出现同一个数字，也不等于已经指定机型。请在机器上核对尺寸。 大纲补不上空白格子。

body.en: Use “Methods of quarrying” to see where this block sits in the source article. The purchasing sentence is the printed fragment, not the encyclopedia prose. A service life, a replacement-hour figure and a wear-rate table are not printed. Leave that field blank. No neighbouring page’s figure is copied onto this row.
body.zh: 用“来源章节：Methods of quarrying”看这一节在来源文章中的位置。采购时要抄的是已印片段，不是百科正文。 使用寿命、更换小时和磨损速率都没有印出。这一栏留空。 不把旁边那一页的数字抄到这一行。

body.en: Nothing about the phrase “Slabs” is a second data sheet. The data-sheet fragment, if one was printed, is quoted next. Hebei Pinjin Machinery (河北品锦机械) in Xingtai does not print a list price for this spare, and the page does not sell it as a small parcel. Write through the contact page by email or WhatsApp. The page calls them Xingtai replacement wear parts, not OEM parts of other pump brands. Unprinted cells stay unprinted.
body.zh: “来源章节：Slabs”这几个字不是第二张数据表。若目录印过数据，下面引用的才是那一句。 邢台河北品锦机械没有为这件配件公布标价，也不按小包裹销售。请走联系页，用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给工厂。 页面写的是邢台替换易损件，不是其他泵品牌的原厂件。 没有印出的格子保持不印。

body.en: The skeleton of this section is the source heading “Problems”. The technical content is only what Xingtai already printed. Email or WhatsApp Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai, and name the 搅拌密封 page plus this size and the quantity. The heading stops there. Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quarry
body.zh: 这一节的骨架是来源标题“来源章节：Problems”。技术内容只限于邢台已经印出的部分。 用邮件或 WhatsApp 写给邢台河北品锦机械，写明搅拌密封这一页、这一尺寸和数量。 标题到此为止。 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Quarry
